description_en: Queries the details of a device registration policy for the current Alibaba Cloud account
description_zh: 查询当前阿里云账号下设备注册策略详情
name: GetRegistrationPolicy

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the device registration policy. You can obtain the value from the following operations:
[ListRegistrationPolicies](~~ListRegistrationPolicies~~): Lists device registration policies.
[GetRegistrationPolicy](~~GetRegistrationPolicy~~): Queries the details of a device registration policy.
[CreateRegistrationPolicy](~~CreateRegistrationPolicy~~): Creates a device registration policy.
[UpdateRegistrationPolicy](~~UpdateRegistrationPolicy~~): Updates a device registration policy
parameters.help_zh:
设备注册策略ID。取值来源：
[ListRegistrationPolicies](~~ListRegistrationPolicies~~)：批量查询设备注册策略。
[GetRegistrationPolicy](~~GetRegistrationPolicy~~)：查询设备注册策略详情。
[CreateRegistrationPolicy](~~CreateRegistrationPolicy~~)：创建设备注册策略。
[UpdateRegistrationPolicy](~~UpdateRegistrationPolicy~~)：更新设备注册策略
parameters.name: policy_id

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the device registration policy was created. The time is in the YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss format
CreateTime.description_zh: 设备注册策略创建时间，格式为 YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss

Description.description_en: The description of the device registration policy
Description.example: 这是一条设备注册策略。

LimitDetail.description_en: The list of limit details for the device registration policy
LimitDetail.description_zh: 设备注册策略限制详情列表

items.description_en: The list of limit details for the device registration policy
items.description_zh: 设备注册策略限制详情列表

DeviceBelong.description_en:
The device ownership. Valid values:
Company: Corporate device.
Personal: Personal device
DeviceBelong.description_zh:
设备归属。取值：
Company：公司设备。
Personal：个人设备

LimitCount.description_en: The limit on the number of device registrations

All.description_en: The total limit on the number of device registrations. This field is valid only when the type of device registration limit is LimitAll
All.description_zh: 设备注册限制总数。当设备注册限制类型为LimitAll时，该字段的值有效

Mobile.description_en: The limit on the number of mobile logons for device registration. This field is valid only when the type of device registration limit is LimitDiff
Mobile.description_zh: 设备注册限制移动端登录数量。当设备注册限制类型为LimitDiff时，该字段的值有效

PC.description_en: The limit on the number of PC logons for device registration. This field is valid only when the type of device registration limit is LimitDiff
PC.description_zh: 设备注册限制PC端登录数量。当设备注册限制类型为LimitDiff时，该字段的值有效

LimitType.description_en:
The type of device registration limit. Valid values:
Unlimited: Unlimited.
LimitAll: Limited by total count.
LimitDiff: Limited by endpoint category
LimitType.description_zh:
设备注册限制类型。取值：
Unlimited：不限制。
LimitAll：按照总数限制。
LimitDiff：按照终端分类限制

MatchMode.description_en:
The target type for policy matching. Valid values:
UserGroupAll: All users.
UserGroupNormal: Specific user groups
MatchMode.description_zh:
策略匹配目标类型。取值：
UserGroupAll：关联全体用户。
UserGroupNormal：关联部分用户组

Name.description_en: The policy name of the device registration policy

PolicyId.description_en: The ID of the device registration policy

Priority.description_en: The policy priority of the device registration policy. A value of 0 indicates the highest priority, and a value of 99 indicates the lowest priority
Priority.description_zh: 设备注册策略优先级。数字0表示优先级最高，数字99表示优先级最低

Status.description_en:
The status of the device registration policy. Valid values:
Enabled: Enabled.
Disabled: Disabled
Status.description_zh:
设备注册策略状态。取值：
Enabled：开启。
Disabled：关闭

UserGroupIds.description_en: The IDs of the user groups associated with the device registration policy. This field has a value only when the target type for policy matching is UserGroupNormal
UserGroupIds.description_zh: 设备注册策略，用户组ID集合。当策略匹配目标类型为UserGroupNormal时，该字段有值

items.description_en: The ID of a user group associated with the device registration policy when the target type for policy matching is UserGroupNormal
items.description_zh: 设备注册策略，策略匹配目标类型为UserGroupNormal时的用户组ID

Whitelist.description_en: The list of whitelisted users for the device registration policy
Whitelist.description_zh: 设备注册策略白名单用户列表

items.description_en: A whitelisted user for the device registration policy
items.description_zh: 设备注册策略白名单用户
